{{Top|leg}}
'''Murkhana Bay''' was a vast body of scarlet [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]]. It had a long, black-sand shoreline upon which [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]] was built.
